Thanks — I’m available Mon 15 Mar 10:00–10:40 JST (works for me). A few notes and one fallback I recommend: 

- ICS best practice: create the calendar event in your corporate Google Calendar set to Asia/Tokyo TZ, then export/send the .ics. That avoids the recipient’s client reinterpreting the time.
- Put the meeting time also in the event description using ISO timestamps ("2027-03-15T10:00+09:00") so even if client TZ is weird they can see the correct local time.
- If we see repeated Calendly TZ issues for Takara, use the Chili Piper hosted link as a fallback; it often respects account-level zone settings and handles SSO users better: https://app.chilipiper.com/r/redwood/demo

I’ll be the primary demo host and will have the performance appendix ready. Assigning a short Pre-demo checklist for Karthik: send Zoom link, attach the quick agenda, include any PoC perf numbers they requested.

—Monica
